points: Broker chain: NSE/BSE (wholesaler) → broker → retail platforms (Zerodha/Upstox) → customer; trading + demat accounts
Limit order (e.g. 100-90) vs market order (current price)
Market participants May-2023: brokers/pro 57.8%, individuals 26.8%, FII 6.1%, corporates 4.3%, others 4.9%, DII 0.1%
Brokers know where retail positions sit — which stock, which strike
Success split: Mindset 70% / Risk management 20% / Strategy 10%
Emotions come from lack of knowledge; fake news planted by brokers/operators/media
Trading is a business, not a game: research, product quality, expense analysis
News media data ≠ company data — always verify
Pre-plan every trade; no setup = no trade; some days only watch (1 in 2 weeks)
Rate yourself: review old trades, know if you're strong in buying or selling
Fundamental vs technical analysis; higher-high / lower-low / sideways (3 months = ~30 trading sessions ≈ 45 calendar days)
Phase-3 bull tops driven by external factors (geopolitics, US panic); professionals create panic where retail holds average positions
Buyer psychology starts in bull; seller in bear — wrong at both extremes
Market cycle: every bull breeds a bear and vice versa
Check yesterday's US market (Dow) — first 1 hr and last 1 hr movement
Monday India = Friday US movement (24-hr cycle)
Sector reacts ±2%, stock ±5% to US cues
US movement always predicts; use first 45 min of India open accordingly
Operators see the market clearly — they create traps where retail is crowded
Trap candle: 7-10 similar opening candles = trap, don't day trade that day
Stop-loss hunting: operator breaks small SL levels to hit retail SLs, then reverses
V-type rally of 5-6 similar candles often = operator game
Breakout points fail 80% of the time; similar candles = fake rally
When all buyers have bought, breakout fails — operators exit into public buying (panic selling creation)
2 attempts at a level: buy side max 2 attempts, sell side max 3
Mark last green candle high/low and last red candle high/low — drastically fall/rise points
Raju & police analogy: resistance at 200/210/220 (police = supply), support 100/105/101 (no police = demand)
Stock falls 10% + index falls 3-5% = consider point
A support broken becomes resistance (change of polarity) — 90.9% strong signal
Double top at supply = sell (2 attempts); W pattern at demand = buy time
Gap analysis: hidden and visible gaps; someone knew news → position created; 2 gaps = stronger signal
Elephant (big) candle + next-day gap-up = strong trend
Two 90-min windows matter: 9:15-10:45 AM and 12:45-1:45 PM IST
No trade until 9:20; watch sector boom 9:25
Entry 9:30-9:45; movement capture by 9:45; return by 12:45; sideways 1:45-2:45
Profit booking: 1:2 first 50%; 2:45 re-enter; 3:15 or 3:30 final exit
After a fall, wait 15 min — a red candle there = supply activation signal
Mobile silent during trading hours
20-40 SMA 'dancing area' (swing): 20 crosses above 40 = uptrend, only buy; cross down = downtrend. Use daily for swing, 2-4 hr for intraday
20-200 SMA: ignore crossovers, watch when gap narrows = 'area of action' — find candlestick pattern there and trade
Stage analysis: Stage 1 = consolidation after downtrend (20/40 cross), Stage 2 = breakout (strongest), Stage 3 = reversal finding, Stage 4 = range (skip)
Dead cat bounce: 20 SMA (15-min) bounce in downtrend is NOT a U-turn; first bounce is dangerous
Trendlines: valid between 22° and 45°; below 22° = weak (90% fail)
SKP-1, SKP-2 patterns referenced throughout
Big green candle in 5/15-min = stock can move ±10%; big red = index -3-7%
Yesterday red candle → today work on open=low concept; yesterday green → open=high
First 10-min candle green → setup open=low (buy side); red → open=high (short side only)
1-candle move of 5%→3% = ignore (no buy); need 2 candles confirmation; SL 1.5%
90% of traders lose (baby report); 25% beginners exit within 1 year
Watchlist: previous-day ±5% NSE stocks → 9:10 pre-market ±3% → 9:15 open ±2% → final list
Software: free (TradingView etc.) vs paid; team + news checking
5paisa F&O lists: OI gainers, short covering, NSE OI spurt
Trade plan: 15-min candle mark high/low → break = trade → 1.5% SL → 3% target → exit 50% → hold rest till 3 PM
If SL hit, reverse position with SL at original price/day high (anti-FOMO)
Nifty flat opening 0.25-0.35% → wait; gap 70 points → wait till 9:45 for bounce entry
Fibonacci A-setup: 61.8% buy level; V-setup: find candle
Budget: 8-13 days before, market moves silently; after budget, trend continues — up 5 days or down 13 days
Election 2014: 6,250→6,640 before result; 15 days down then 8-9 day continuous rally
Election 2019: sideways 15 Apr-15 May, then crashed 3 months later
Election 2024: like 2014 (7-8 days down, then 9-10 day rally)
DII/MF flows mandatory due to SIP — structural support
30 days practice (paper), then 100 days cash equity with ₹20,000
Warning: 'Capital zero in 3 month' — the risk is real
45-day practice cycle for setups
